summary: US equities re-rated through the 2026-10-14 session: the latest CPI print came in above expectations and several Fed officials leaned hawkish, so with the fact layer captured at 19:37:42Z on 2026-10-14 (a late-session snapshot roughly 22 minutes before the 16:00 ET cash close, so the US leg is not an official closing print) the composite risk score rose to 59.31 from 53.05 on 2026-10-13, 6.26 points higher session over session, and the regime flag flipped from goldilocks to risk_on. Breadth and cross-asset confirmation drove the move rather than volatility: cross_asset scored 75.0 (6 of the 8 production-scored signals triggered) and equity_structure 66.6, while volatility stayed at 18.9 with VIX at 15.27. All 22 published sector and theme rows finished lower, led by AI Infrastructure -6.91%, Data Centers -6.54% and Quantum Computing -5.80%, with AMD -5.55% and NVDA -3.08% leading the semis complex down. One caveat: the composite's own trend_1d of 6.15 is measured against the same-day 10:40Z generation at 53.16 rather than against 2026-10-13, so the true session-over-session move is 6.26. Confidence slipped to 0.8932 with internal consistency at 0.6058, and the macro legs still carry 2026-10-09 vintages, so the composite level is firmer than its attribution.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation is again the largest single contribution at 11.25: 6 of the 8 production-scored signals triggered (ratio 0.75), including the dollar index at 121.6023 and the 10Y real rate at 2.91.
Real rates remain the macro pressure point: the 10Y real rate of 2.91 sits at the 99.68 percentile and the nominal 10Y of 5.24 at the 99.52 percentile, contributing 4.984 and 4.952 respectively.
High-yield credit is the second-largest contribution at 5.228: HY OAS holds at 3.16 (percentile 65.35) and has not widened through the 4.0 trigger, so the risk is priced rather than realised.
Equity structure deteriorated materially: 40 new lows against 1 new high (new_lows_ratio 0.2564, new_highs_ratio 0.0064) with semis_relative at -3.8813, lifting the dimension to 66.6.

Overnight reverse repo fell to 0.201 from 0.275, the 1.12 percentile, contributing 3.91 to a liquidity_credit dimension now at 63.15: the facility is effectively drained, so it no longer signals abundant excess reserves.

supporting_signals.claim: CPI surprised to the upside: headline CPI 3.71725 against a prior 3.35302 and core 2.56584, so the disinflation path the Fed needs is not yet visible in the data.

Risk appetite was repriced across all 22 published sector and theme rows without exception, and the damage is concentrated in the AI complex: AI Infrastructure -6.9097, Data Centers -6.5377, Quantum Computing -5.7974 and Networking -5.6753.
The semis complex led the decline: AMD -5.5489, AVGO -3.1471, NVDA -3.0763 and MU -3.0425, with TSLA -2.3799 on the auto leg.
The unwind is global rather than US-only: China's memory and semiconductor names fell in step, 688825.SH -2.1068, 603986.SH -4.4608, 301308.SZ -4.1409 and 688008.SH -5.9524.
Crypto traded as a risk asset rather than a hedge: BTC fell to 81696.0 (-1.78672) while ETH 2428.16 and SOL 104.22 each lost more than 3.

contradicting_signals.claim: Volatility does not confirm the equity move: VIX 15.27 (25.4 percentile) and realized vol 10.3674 leave the volatility dimension at 18.9, the lowest of the 6, so this is a valuation repricing rather than a stress event.
Credit is calm rather than cracking: HY OAS at 3.16 did not trigger the widening flag and IG OAS held at 0.83 with no change, so the equity selloff has not yet transmitted into funding stress.

There is no classic defensive bid: the dollar index firmed to 121.6023 (65.2 percentile) and the 10Y real rate held at 2.91, so the pressure is a discount-rate story rather than a growth scare or a flight to safety.
The trend dimension is barely dented at 45.07: price sits 6.2395% above the 200-day average and the 52-week drawdown is only -1.2438%, so the structural uptrend is intact.
The headline 1-day trend of 6.15 is not a session-over-session move: it is measured against the same-day 10:40Z generation at 53.16, and against the 2026-10-13 score of 53.05 the true change is 6.26.
Model confidence fell to 0.8932 with internal consistency at 0.6058 and coverage at 0.93, and the calibration policy is still provisional: the composite level is firmer than its attribution.

The macro legs carry different vintages inside one layer: the 10Y at 5.24 and the real rate at 2.91 are 2026-10-09 prints while credit OAS is a 2026-10-13 print, so part of the macro pressure predates today's CPI.

what_changed_today: US CPI rose to 3.71725 on the 2026-09 print against a 3.35302 prior, and pricing flipped from cuts to a hike: the FedWatch implied rate is 4.13 with action=hike.
The composite risk score rose to 59.31 from 53.05 on 2026-10-13, a 6.26-point session-over-session increase, with the regime flag flipping from goldilocks to risk_on.
Cross-asset confirmation climbed to 0.75 as 6 of the 8 production-scored signals triggered, adding 11.25 to the composite on its own.

All 22 published sector and theme rows finished lower, with the AI complex taking the worst of it: AI Infrastructure -6.9097, Data Centers -6.5377, Quantum Computing -5.7974 and Networking -5.6753, while Gaming -1.2233 and Industrial Automation -1.2665 held up best.
Mega-cap semis led the tape down: AMD -5.5489, AVGO -3.1471, NVDA -3.0763 and MU -3.0425, with NVDA at 221.490005 in the snapshot.
Equity structure deteriorated sharply: 40 new lows against 1 new high, breadth above the 200-day average at 0.4774 across 155 names, and small-cap relative at -10.7599.
Spot gold broke below 4100 dollars and the gold risk signal printed -1.2664, so the traditional hedge failed, while copper fell -0.9883 in step.
The 30-year Treasury yield fell 3.2 basis points intraday to 5.531% alongside the equity selloff, so the long end rallied into the CPI upside rather than with it.
China's semiconductor and memory names extended the decline: 688825.SH -2.1068, 603986.SH -4.4608, 301308.SZ -4.1409, 688008.SH -5.9524 and 688525.SH -4.4025.

Overnight RRP dropped to 0.201 from 0.275 and the dollar index firmed to 121.6023, while crypto fell roughly in line with equities: BTC 81696.0 (-1.78672), ETH 2428.16 (-3.16698) and SOL 104.22 (-3.12484).
AI financing became the new fault line: CoreWeave shares fell about 15% with its bond yields near 15%, and BlackRock's Fink warned that a data center moratorium could trigger a recession.
watch_next: TSM reports on 2026-10-15 against a 4.45 forecast, the first hard test of the AI capex narrative after Semiconductor Equipment fell -4.4217 in a single session.
US PPI and Advance Retail Sales land on 2026-10-15 at 12:30Z; they decide whether the CPI upside is a tariff-and-energy one-off or a broadening inflation impulse.
Whether the FedWatch implied rate of 4.13 with action=hike survives the next data: a hike priced into a weakening tape is the core asymmetry.
Whether the volatility complex finally confirms: VIX at 15.27 and realized vol at 10.3674 still leave the dimension at 18.9, the calmest of the 6.
Credit is the tell: HY OAS at 3.16 must widen through the 4.0 trigger for the selloff to escalate from an equity-only repricing into a funding event.
Breadth follow-through: whether the 40 new lows of 2026-10-14 expand further and breadth above the 200-day average breaks below 0.4774.
Regional follow-through: Asia's semiconductor and memory legs set the tone for 2026-10-15, with today's Semiconductor Equipment -4.4217 and Memory -3.8606 as the reference points.
Earnings calendar: NFLX on 2026-10-20 and META on 2026-10-21 — mega-cap guidance is the next scheduled source of information on whether AI capex is being marked down.
The inflation follow-through after CPI: whether core CPI at 2.56584 and the 5-year breakeven at 2.33 move together decides whether the 2.91 real rate is transient or durable.

bull_case.title: Bull case: a rates repricing, not a growth break
points: Volatility is not confirming stress: VIX 15.27 and realized vol 10.3674 keep the dimension at 18.9.
Credit is orderly: HY OAS at 3.16 has not widened through the 4.0 trigger and IG OAS is unchanged at 0.83.
The trend structure is intact: price is 6.2395% above the 200-day average with a 52-week drawdown of only -1.2438%.
The dollar index at 121.6023 reflects the demand side rather than only the discount rate, and a TSM beat could repair the AI capex narrative quickly.

base_case.title: Base case: caution at 59.31 with a two-sided tape
points: The composite at 59.31 sits in the caution band with the regime flag at risk_on, so the model has not yet signalled a broad de-risking.
The pressure is concentrated rather than broad: 6 of the 8 production-scored cross-asset signals triggered while the volatility dimension stayed at 18.9.
Semis and AI infrastructure remain the swing factor: AI Infrastructure -6.9097 was the worst row and Cloud Computing -4.3027 the proxy read.
Confidence of 0.8932 with consistency at 0.6058 argues for range trading rather than a directional call.

bear_case.title: Bear case: a hike into a decelerating tape
points: The discount rate is already extreme: the 10Y real rate at 2.91 sits at the 99.68 percentile and the nominal 10Y at 5.24 at the 99.52 percentile.
Breadth is breaking: 40 new lows against 1 new high, breadth above the 200-day average at 0.4774 and small-cap relative at -10.7599.
If HY OAS widens from 3.16 through 4.0, the liquidity_credit dimension at 63.15 still has room to add materially.
Reverse repo at 0.201 removes the buffer: the model's liquidity reading has almost no cushion left to absorb a funding shock.
